input.quote: HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information.
input.rationale: Section 1.4 is the only grant running in our favour (access to and the right to use HDI's hosting system, software and Content administration tools). It is silent on affiliates and on contractors acting on our behalf, with no mechanism to add them — failing even the fallback — and silent on revocability, so HDI could argue the access is withdrawable at will. One appended sentence extends the grant to our affiliates and contractors, makes it irrevocable during the term absent our uncured material breach (perpetual and irrevocable to the extent paid up in full), and confirms transfer to a successor, reinforcing Section 10.3. The outbound Marks licence in Section 6.1 runs in our favour as licensor and is not flagged.

ops.text: The access and use rights granted to the Company under this Section 1.4 extend to the Company's affiliates and to contractors acting on the Company's behalf, are irrevocable during the term of this Agreement except in the case of an uncured material breach by the Company and, to the extent paid up in full, are perpetual and irrevocable, and may be transferred to any successor to the Company's business by merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added one sentence extending the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since they operate and support the Site for us, and confirming the rights are irrevocable during the term save for our uncured material breach (perpetual and irrevocable to the extent paid up) and pass to a successor.
proposal.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use rights to Company affiliates and contractors, make them irrevocable during the term absent the Company's uncured material breach (and perpetual and irrevocable to the extent paid up), and confirm transfer to a successor.

mappings.element: Licence extended to contractors acting on Customer's behalf.
Subscription licences terminable only for uncured material breach.
